extra.reason: Android/Kotlin/Compose Gradle project scaffolded: version catalog, AGP 8.5.2/Kotlin 2.0.20/Compose BOM, minSdk 26/target+compileSdk 34, ktlint + Android Lint wired in, gradlew wrapper generated, GitHub Actions CI workflow added. Verified with ./gradlew ktlintCheck lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug — all green.

Added shared MediaWiki/Wikibase REST API client (wiki.asaf.wikisayit.network): MediaWikiSite enum for Commons/Wikidata base URLs, pluggable AuthTokenProvider seam for the future OAuth epic, MediaWikiClient with get/post backed by Ktor (OkHttp engine, kotlinx.serialization JSON), and MediaWikiApiException with best-effort error parsing across the REST/Wikibase error shapes. Covered by 4 unit tests using ktor-client-mock (auth header attach/omit, error parsing, JSON body POST). Verified via ./gradlew ktlintCheck lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug — all green.

Wired up Hilt DI (KSP-based compiler) with @HiltAndroidApp/@AndroidEntryPoint on the Application/MainActivity, and a NetworkModule binding the s-l2j.4 MediaWiki client layer (HttpClient, AuthTokenProvider, WikimediaClients) as app-scoped singletons. Established the MVVM/state-holder pattern screens will follow: WelcomeViewModel (@HiltViewModel) exposes a private MutableStateFlow as a read-only StateFlow, mutated only via event-handling functions, consumed in Compose via hiltViewModel() + collectAsStateWithLifecycle(). Pinned hilt-navigation-compose to 1.2.0 since 1.4.0 pulls transitive androidx artifacts requiring compileSdk 35-37/AGP 9.1+ that are out of scope here. Added a ViewModel unit test. Verified via ./gradlew ktlintCheck lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug — all green (6 tests passing).

Added the top-level Compose Navigation graph (type-safe routes via kotlinx.serialization) covering all 9 named destinations from DESIGN.md — Profile, Language, ListSource, Recording, Review, Contribution, Settings, Stats, About — each backed by a placeholder screen except Profile (wired to the existing WelcomeScreen). Added WikiSayItAppScaffold: a shared TopAppBar with the app name and a hamburger IconButton opening a DropdownMenu (Settings/Stats/About), wrapping the NavHost content. MainActivity now owns the NavController and composes scaffold+navhost together. Verified with ./gradlew ktlintCheck lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug (all green) AND by installing the debug APK on a booted emulator (AVD 'freemzog') and exercising it live: Get Started button increments ViewModel state on screen, hamburger menu opens, and tapping About navigates to the About placeholder — screenshots confirmed no crashes and correct behavior end-to-end.

Added local persistence: Room (profiles + languages + a recording_stats log) for structured data, and Preferences DataStore for simple app settings (auto-use-last-profile, last-used-profile-id) — matching DESIGN.md's Settings/Stats requirements. Schema: speaker_profiles / profile_languages (FK, cascade delete, proficiency enum) / recording_stats (FK, entry type + timestamp, queried via GROUP BY for Stats' by-type and by-year-month totals). Repository layer (ProfileRepository/StatsRepository/SettingsRepository) wired into Hilt via a new DataModule + DataBindingsModule, ready for later epics to consume. Instrumented tests (androidTest, run on emulator AVD 'freemzog') caught and drove the fix of a real bug: Room's @Upsert returns -1 (not the row id) on its update path, so saveProfile()'s language-replacement logic was writing profile_languages rows under profileId=-1 for existing profiles, tripping a foreign-key constraint — fixed by preferring the caller-supplied profileId over the @Upsert return value when updating. All 5 instrumented tests pass; verified full gate via ./gradlew ktlintCheck lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug (green) plus connectedDebugAndroidTest (5/5 passing).

I18N infrastructure verified end-to-end: all user-facing strings live in strings.xml/plurals (none hardcoded — confirmed by turning on lint's HardcodedText, RtlHardcoded and RtlCompat checks as build-breaking errors in app/lint.xml, which passed clean), tap-count text switched from a '%d time(s)' hack to a proper <plurals> resource so languages with real plural grammar (not just singular/other) render correctly. android:supportsRtl="true" was already set; Compose derives layout direction from locale automatically so no code changes were needed for mirroring. Added a full Hebrew translation (values-he, with a values-iw duplicate — Android's resource qualifier resolution still requires the legacy 'iw' folder name for Hebrew despite the locale reporting as 'he', confirmed by testing) to prove the pipeline. Verified live on the emulator via : top bar and hamburger menu mirror to the right, all strings translate, and the one/two/other Hebrew plural forms ('נלחץ פעם אחת' / 'פעמיים' / 'פעמים') all render correctly. Verified full gate via ./gradlew ktlintCheck lint testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug — all green.

All 6 foundation tasks complete: Android/Compose scaffolding, MediaWiki/Wikibase REST client, Hilt DI + MVVM pattern, Compose nav graph + app scaffold, Room/DataStore persistence, and I18N/RTL infrastructure. Each verified independently via ktlint/lint/unit tests plus live emulator runs. This unblocks the List Sourcing, Audio Recording, Authentication, and App Shell epics.

Two fixes: (1) WikidataExistenceChecker.check() now verifies just a form's own P443 status when it's already resolved (formId set) instead of re-expanding the whole lexeme's missing forms again — this was the '3 became 7 entries' bug, triggered when skip-all-and-return-to-list left an already-expanded queue sitting behind the list screen's Check button; skipCurrentWord() now lands on CHECKED with accurate counts instead of FRESH, removing that trigger too. (2) AndroidAudioSource now reads fixed 20ms frames instead of one whole AudioRecord-buffer per frame, whose size varies a lot by device — the likely cause of the 'recording never stops / same word shown again' flakiness, since a too-large frame miscalibrates the speech/silence detector's timing and can crop a genuine take down to nothing (misreported as TooShort). Note: (2) is a well-reasoned fix from code review, not device-verified, since I don't have a physical Android device to reproduce on.

LanguageScreen now auto-selects the profile's single language and advances immediately (LaunchedEffect keyed on profile), mirroring the existing auto-select-last-profile pattern in ProfileScreen. Multi-language profiles are unaffected.

DoneScreen now shows the actual uploadDoneCount instead of the total approved count, and only claims 'every file is on Commons' when nothing is pending; when uploads were left for later it shows an honest partial-completion message (done_explainer_partial) instead. Filed s-5c0 as a follow-up for the deeper gap: pending uploads aren't actually persisted/retried across app restarts despite contribution_leaving_note's claim.

Root cause: the shared HttpClient (MediaWikiHttpClientFactory) sent no User-Agent header. Per Wikimedia's User-Agent policy, unidentified clients get throttled -- burst requests during pageprops resolution (one GET per 50-title batch, ~19 batches for this category) got 429'd, and the code's runCatching{}.getOrNull() silently treated each 429 as 'no data', yielding 0 total entries. Added a descriptive User-Agent (WikiSayIt/0.1.0 + repo URL) to the shared client; reproduced against the live he.wikipedia.org API with the user's exact category ('סופרים כותבי עברית') before and after -- went from 0 to 1300 resolved entries. Filed s-fns as a follow-up for the broader silent-failure-swallowing pattern in the list-building network calls.

Removed the false 'retried on next launch' claim from contribution_leaving_note and added an honest note next to Leave for later explaining recordings stay on-device only; follow-up for real persistence filed as s-o8f.
